notes.title: New Engine
notes.content:
Dear players, there are some issues in compatibility with new processors and OS which are causing problems. For this reasons i renewed the engine of the game, i was testing it in the last days and seems to be fine. Even if the performances of the new engine are a little bit lower than the old one, it has practically a full compatibility with all the systems (linux included).

Don't worry you will not lose your game saves or anything like that, i will upload it in the next days and i will be happy to have your feedback as always. Probably for most of you the experience will not change at all, but if you face problems or issues please let me know i'll be more than happy to help.

Thanks
Roberto

notes.title: Dungeons are here!
notes.content:
As requested by the community i have added the Dungeons!

They are special buildings which are entrances to dungeon instances for parties. Each Dungeon has its own level: 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25, and the parties will decide according to their level and abilities to enter in them or not.  Beating a dungeon leads to experience, gold and treasures. If they fail they will be kicked out with 1 life point. 

Dungeons are different from a new world areas and it is not possible to look inside them (for the moment). It is possible to recognize them on the map because they have a combat icon on the top:

Dungeons encourages the formation of parties and it stack with the grouping point building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133915/6d788931a5595fcb9cdcd44ef40f126d962a813a.png[/img]

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Bypass for Alt-Tab issue on Windows 11
notes.content:
Bypass for the Alt-Tab Problem on Windows 11. 
Pressing Alt (Right or Left) will make the game go to windowed mode before the switch application. It's not the complete solution yet but should avoid the annoying situation of having the game in background restoring it. Pressing again Alt with the focus on the game will restore the fullscreen. 

I will try to find a better solution asap.
Thanks to "The Obtuse Rubber Goose" to spot the problem.

notes.title: Version 2.0 Released!
notes.content:
Dear Players, 

It's a pleasure for me to release the new version of the game as FWOT Birthday Pack!
One year is passed and i'm really enthusiastic about feedback i got, for this i would thank you all!

I really tried to implement all the features requested and some others i would like to add since the beginning! I hope you will enjoy it as i did coding it! 

This new version of the game includes: 
[list]
[*] Avatar: you can create an avatar for you to play and go around your MMORPG (or teleport it where you want). You can see your character grow and gain abilities as well as train exactly like a player or you can jump to whatever level you want to test your game.

[*] Conquerable Buildings: a new class of buildings which is a challenge for your players. There are 4 buildings for this category: a defensive tower, a gold mine, a reliquary and a fort. Each of them if conquered by the players killing all the monster will give special bonuses in the area/all the players in the world where is located.

[*] Breakable objects: objects that can be destroyed by players (to reappear after a while) which make the game more fun for them. Hide the treasure in boxes ore create passages in the walls.

[*] Professions: players may choose a profession between Mining, Herbalism and Cooking. You can place resources to be used by the players for their profession. The players will sell or use what they produce. Discover new objects to increase the materials they can gather. 

[*] New quest trigger: a new quest type is added to create places where only the users with a specific quest can access. 

[*] Houses on sale: most of the houses you build can be bought by the players to use them as rest point and to increase their fidelity.  

[*] Looking for party building: a new building where players will look for parties. This will let you control the behavior of them and creating areas "for groups".

[*] Guilds improved: now guilds are also places where the community of members supports itself with a deposit of gold left in the guild: the wealthiest make donations, those who need it take some gold.

[*] More Scenarios: more than 60 new scenario elements added, including special effects and interactive objects.

[*] New Ground types: renewed the old ones and added new ones including "scary meat ground" to create very bloody places to visit.

[*] A new Event: an Ice Gorilla i ready to freeze your players which are looking for experience and treasures.

[*] Contextual Sound: No more too many sounds, you can hear what you are looking at, only the sounds produced by elements in your view will be reproduced with an higher volume in the very center which will fade toward the borders.

[*] Ambient music: changing the background of an area, the music will adapt making the atmosphere more suited to the context.

[*] A new and even more complex AI: a brand new artificial intelligence which copes with all the new elements in the game.

[*] Renew of magic and ability effects: most of the visual effects of players' ability is brand new and in higher quality. The same is done with sounds of them.

[*] Game balancing: costs and effects in the game are balanced for a more pleasant user experience. 
[/list]

Feedback and suggestions are welcome as usual, feel free to contact me as private message, by mail or directly on the forum. I'll check them every day.

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133915/2fdc7ae4a3c75486293bb057ad5a04b0622f648a.png[/img]



p.s.
I tested everything by myself and i hope to have cleared the game from all the bugs. Please be patience in the next days, as usual i'll try to fix everything as soon it is reported by the game! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133915/2ee2f51b00331ac86c50a815a64e5a4f99059f75.png[/img]

notes.title: More variegated treasures and Action house!
notes.content:
Now the rare items can be researched in the research and development section. Researching treasures means that the players will have a bigger list of possible rare items to find in the "treasure spots" (The blue ones you place!)
Those rare items can be weapons and armors to equip but also other objects that must be sold in an auction house! Moreover your players may start to desire some rare items if they are rich so they will go to the auction house to buy them.  

Both sell and buy will generate happiness (and get money from the players! especially the rich ones!)

The Auction house can be discovered at Lv.1 of the buildings.
As usual... be aware new treasures implemented in your MMO lead to new Bugs! (as in the reality!).

I will improve the Action house system in the future to make it more "interactive", probably in the release 1.3 at the end of August. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.1 Released

I will continue to provide support for all the necessary fixes and game balancing, but for now I am entering a phase of study of the possible evolutions of the game with more method (due the fact that the game is no longer in early access) :D

Things that are currently part of the plan for the next release (1.2):
- Wars between guilds in PVP
- Customizable buildings (general components to be composed)
- Campaign mode (series of missions with pre-built parks with objectives to be achieved)

For all this I need your [b]support[/b]!
All suggestions will be considered to add / replace / modify the plans for the future development, so use the Community Hub or the email fantasyworldonlinetycoon@gmail.com (Thank you for all the emails you sent me so far!).

Enjoy the game!
Roberto

notes.title: Update big BOSS combat
notes.content:
Improved the engagement and the combat with big Bosses and the effect of players and monsters special abilities. Now the players don't need to be under the boss to combat with him but they can do it from a short distance. Moreover all the players can attack simultaneously the boss!

Other small things:
- The experience and gold are shared between all players in combat with the boss when he dies
- The Boss last one week (after the event activation)
- The Events can be held 1 time each month... if the event properties are changed they will be effective next activation.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: Events System Added!
notes.content:
Hi there, it's time for another big update of the game!
As promised now it is possible to create events in the game! 

The events are discovered by the "Research and Development Department" at level 1 as new building:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37133915/cd9425c357e8ff69e6ff48f7465bd31d38cad314.png[/img]

This can be placed on the map and will open a new menu for events. An event can be "held" 1 time each month (you choose the da) and may be on of the following categories:
- Healing: these events heals all the players in the area. 
- Skill power up: these events increases the level the special skills in the area. 
- Experience Boost: these events increases the exp. gained by next monster kill
- Players Gathering: this is a social event where people meet and talk. 
- Boss Spawn: A Huge BOSS monster spawn. The level of the bosses will be between 25 and 35 and the players will try to kill him all together. Big monster big reward!

Please let me know what you think in the community Hub! 
And if you like the game, please leave me a review! 

ENJOY THE GAME!
